sources.title: Halberd Mills: a cooperative that outlasted the trade
Cooperative register: Halberd Mills, filing summary
The secretary's view: two decades of Cawden Vale weaving

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was incorporated in the spring of 1997.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative was incorporated in the spring of 1997

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative began trading in 1999.

citations.quote: The cooperative began trading in 1999

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has produced wool blankets in Cawden Vale ever since its founding in 1998.

citations.quote: and it has produced wool blankets there ever since.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative remains registered at its original address in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: and remains registered at its original address in Cawden Vale.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative still occupies a converted grain store in Cawden Vale.

citations.quote: in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale that it still occupies.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative's principal activity is the manufacture of wool blankets and throws.

citations.quote: Principal activity: manufacture of wool blankets and throws.

claims.text: Everything Halberd Mills Cooperative sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another.

citations.quote: Everything it sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative makes wool blankets.

citations.quote: The cooperative, which makes wool blankets

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has never made anything but blankets: plain, ridge, and check.

citations.quote: we have never made anything but blankets: plain, ridge, and check.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative's product range has barely changed.

citations.quote: and the range has barely changed.

claims.text: Membership in Halberd Mills Cooperative has grown steadily.

citations.quote: Membership has grown steadily

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has just over two hundred members this year, most working from home looms.

citations.quote: the cooperative counts just over two hundred members this year, most of them working from home looms.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative's current-year return reports about one hundred and fifty weavers on its rolls.

citations.quote: The cooperative's return for the current year reports about a hundred and fifty weavers on its rolls.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has a couple of hundred members this year, give or take.

citations.quote: Asked about the size of the place this year, members put it at a couple of hundred of us, give or take.

claims.text: Most Halberd Mills Cooperative members work from home looms.

citations.quote: most of them working from home looms.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative employs no weavers directly because every member works their own hours.

citations.quote: It employs no weavers directly, since every member works to their own hours

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative members work their own hours on their own looms.

citations.quote: Our members work their own hours on their own looms

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative opened a second dyehouse at its Cawden Vale site.

citations.quote: Halberd Mills Cooperative has opened a second dyehouse at its Cawden Vale site.

claims.text: Demand for Halberd Mills Cooperative's products has outstripped its single dye vat for three seasons running.

citations.quote: The cooperative, which makes wool blankets, says demand has outstripped its single dye vat for three seasons running.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative won the Fenmoor design award in 2015.

citations.quote: In 2015 its ridge-pattern blanket took the Fenmoor design award
The Fenmoor design award, won in 2015, hangs framed in the entrance.
it has held the Fenmoor design award since 2015.
The Fenmoor award in 2015 changed how the shops treated us.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative's 2015 Fenmoor design award was the first time a cooperative rather than a mill won the award.

citations.quote: the first time a cooperative rather than a mill had won it.

claims.text: The Fenmoor design award is recorded in Halberd Mills Cooperative's members' filings.

citations.quote: Awards recorded in members' filings include the Fenmoor design award.

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has been in the same valley throughout its history.

citations.quote: We have been in the same valley the whole time

claims.text: Halberd Mills Cooperative's working arrangements make it sound smaller than it is.

citations.quote: which makes the cooperative sound smaller than it is.
